inventory_method: SKILL.md paths excluding test/fixture/example/vendor/build directories; same parent-directory name grouped within each repository, preferring skills/ and shorter paths. This is a path/name heuristic, not content-equivalence deduplication. Root skills use the repository name. Counts are pinned to recorded commits.
exclusions: Do not add thousands of near-identical SaaS wrappers, personas, branded visual styles or installers. Specialized CAD, laboratory/clinical and offensive-security procedures require a concrete task and verified toolchain before adding them. Existing general workflows cover overlapping outcomes.
